A [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''individual''' owned a [[Unidentified traveling air rodeo|traveling air rodeo]], which at some point featured trained [[Thranta/Legends|thrantas]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of large, winged creatures. Some [[Time/Legends|time]] while she owned the rodeo and was [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to her [[Unidentified individual (rodeo owner's husband)|husband]], the owner was kidnapped by an [[Unidentified animal rights group|animal rights group]] who wanted to stop traveling [[air rodeo]]s. The group did so in an attempt to show the owner how the thrantas felt during transport when they lacked the [[Star/Legends|sunlight]] necessary for photosynthesis.

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual was the owner of a [[Unidentified traveling air rodeo|traveling air rodeo]] that featured trained [[Thranta/Legends|thrantas]], a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of large, flying creatures. At some point in her life, she and a [[Unidentified individual (rodeo owner's husband)|man]] were [[Marriage/Legends|married]]. Some [[Time/Legends|time]] after she was married, an [[Unidentified animal rights group|animal rights group]] kidnapped the owner with the intent of starving her for a [[Standard week/Legends|week]] to show her how hungry the thrantas became during transportation when they were deprived of the [[Star/Legends|sunlight]] necessary for photosynthesis. The group did not ask for a ransom due to their goal being to stop the operation of traveling [[air rodeo]]s.<ref name="Rodeo" />

{{RPGseed}}
After the owner was captured, a known group of individuals in the area were asked to rescue her. The owner's husband was willing to pay the group for their efforts in rescuing his wife.<ref name="Rodeo" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The air rodeo owner first appeared as part of an adventure idea in "[[Rodeo Thranta]]," an article written by [[Jeff Quick]] as part of the ''[[Creature Feature]]'' series of articles for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published on [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s [[Wizards.com|website]]. The article was released on [[December 12]], [[2002]], with the adventure ideas and characters being usable by gamemasters at any time after thrantas were first used in air rodeos, which happened before the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of the thrantas' [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. The player characters had the option of rescuing her with or without her husband paying them.<ref name="Rodeo" />
